$comment: THE OFFICIAL IMAGE REGISTRIES of Dédalo — the ONE list, machine-read. Dédalo publishes the SAME signed image (one digest) to every PROVISIONED entry; operators choose any of them, a registry of their own, or a local build. Consumers, all derived from this file: (1) CI — scripts/ci/image_release.ts through src/core/update/image_registries.ts (publish targets, secret names, signing identity); (2) the Docker host — deploy/image_registries.sh, GENERATED by `bun run registries:gen`, sourced by install.sh and the image updater; (3) the operator manual — the generated table in docs/install/docker.md; (4) the code-update panel — names the configured repository official primary, official mirror or custom. `provisioned` is a fact about the PUBLISHER: the repository exists under Dédalo's control and the release workflow can publish to it; whether a given version exists there is probed by each consumer, never assumed. An unprovisioned entry names NO address (repository null, a reason instead) and every consumer treats it as unavailable. TO PROVISION an entry: set `repository` and `provisioned: true`, regenerate (`bun run registries:gen`), add its two secrets (secret auth only) to the GitHub repository dedalia-org/dedalo — they are referenced ONLY by the publish job, which is bound to the protected `image-release` environment, then dispatch image-release.yml on the release channel once per existing release tag: that run copies the already-published digest to the new registry and never rebuilds. Gate: test/unit/image_registries_tripwire.test.ts.
